title: People Are Different Like Roses In A Garden
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum. As-salaamu `alaykum! Marhaban! Ahlan wa sahlan! Marhaban, good tidings for
Muslims! Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) Yaa Rabbana, Rabb ighfir w 'arham wa Anta khayru 'r-rahimeen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma as-salaat wa 's-salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'l-aawwaleen wa ’l-aakhireen, (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Sayyidina Muhammad wa `alaa aalihi wa saahbihi wa `alaa jamee`i 'l-anbiyaa wa 'l-mursaleen wa
khudamaa'i shara`ihim wa `alaa `ibaadAllahi 's-saaliheen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum, from east to west, from north to south. Listen and try to understand and
obey the holy commands of Allah Almighty. As long as people are not obeying the holy orders of Heavens,
they will always be in never-ending troubles, in their physical beings and in their works. Everything is going
to be as a spear piercing them and no one is going to be happy. Therefore, we are calling all Mankind from
east to west, from north to south, to try to be obedient servants. If not, they can't reach any pleasure here or
Hereafter. If a person is not making his Lord, Almighty Allah, pleased with him, his life here and Hereafter is
going to be in troubles and he will be thrown into Trouble Valleys.
O People! Come and listen; we must listen and obey. If you are asking for happiness and pleasure,
pleasement and Paradise, a sweet life here and Paradise on the Day of Resurrection, endlessly up to Eternity,

why are you not taking care? 21st century people are like drunk ones, never thinking, every 24 hours running
after dunya, asking to be in pleasure here, but it is impossible. They are eating but not digesting, drinking but
not tasting, and sleeping with tablets, which is not a sweet life. A sweet life is if he eats dry bread with salt and
water, and his conscience is restful, or if he sleeps on a stone and he is happy. People are sleeping on such
beds, but do not taste a good taste, and they are not in rest. They are always using drugs. When a person is
using drugs, he is never tasting and he is like a dead person. For sleep there is a kind of rest granted from
Paradise. Some people are sleeping and at the beginning of their sleep their spiritual being is taken by angels,
going around. People take drugs to sleep, but they are like a dead body. The lives of believers and lovers of
Allah and His most beloved servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) are sweet
when they awaken, and when they are sleeping, their lives are also sweet, but people are not understanding
spirituality that gives pleasure to people.
In past times when people were working, they would clap and sing, "Ilahee, ilahee," heavenly singing, like
tasbeeh, glorifying their Lord, and angels were descended and moved with them in such pleasement and
pleasure. Now they are on tractors and there is no singing. Their ears are like deaf ones and that poisonous
smoke is coming on them. They changed and are saying, "We are living in the time of technology, which is
making our lives easy, not like before when people plowed with an ox." They are happy on a tractor, but
because of that poisoned smoke, all night their heads and hearts are suffering in pain. That is their
technology!
O People! Come back to nature! The Lord of Heavens is making nature madad, help you, so you must come
back to nature. People are fighting nature with so many poisonous things. O Mankind living on this planet!
You must change your life. Technology is killing you and daily it is giving much more trouble for you! O
Western People! Hear and obey! Leave technology. O our heedless Muslim world! Don't follow western
foolishness! Leave technology and come to nature! That is important. From east to west, you must listen and
hear if you want a sweet life here and Hereafter.
La hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem. Yaa Rabbee! Now Shaytan has established its
kingdom and we must try to destroy it, to finish it! Allah Almighty made Mankind as brothers. (Mawlana
Shaykh stands)

••• •••••••• •••••••• •••••• •••••••••••• •••• •••••• •••••••• ••••••••••••••• •••••••• •••••••••••
Yaa ayyuha 'n-naas inna khalaqnaakum min dhakarin wa untha wa ja`alnaakum shu`ooban wa qabaa'il. O
Mankind! Verily We created you from male and female, and made you nations and tribes. (49:13)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah, Allah. Allah, Allah. And Allah Almighty granted people of every tribe or nation
special characteristics. English people, German, Pakistani, Japanese, Turks, Kurdish, Azeri people, and
everyone is granted something. The Lord of Heavens is asking to make this world in different colors, like a
rose garden. You can't find a white rose fighting with a red rose. Countless other flowers are living altogether
and not fighting, but what about Mankind, why do you fight and kill? It is not an honor! They say they
reached the top point of civilization, but they are liars! What is their civilization, to send those missiles to
destroy? They are burning everything, including so many creatures. Why? Have we been honored with that?
Have we been ordered to kill, destroy, burn, and give trouble to each other? Is that "civilization"? Ptuuh (spit)
on their civilization! But holy orders will take them away and a big cleaning is coming, because people are
followers of Shaytan.
O People! Come, listen, obey, and follow the holy commands of Allah Almighty. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits.) May Allah forgive us, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s). Huuuuuu.
Fatihah.
Enough. Good tidings for listeners of heavenly orders, and bad tidings will come to those who are not
following heavenly orders and pleasures. May Allah forgive us. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee.
Fatihah.
